newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico cattle report, feeder export price -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico cattle report, feeder export price -USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Monday that around 350 head were exported into the United States at two crossing points Friday.
Through Laredo, Texas, around 250 head were sold and through Del Rio, Texas, around 100 head were traded. At both points, there was not enough trade to establish quote prices.
